name: Campidanese Sardinian

ancestors.notes: Campidanese is a primary dialect group of Sardinian (macrolanguage srd), sharing sc's grapheme inventory.

notes: Campidanese Sardinian (ISO 639-3 sro). Southern Sardinian dialect group, more phonologically innovative than Logudorese: heavier intervocalic lenition of voiceless stops (p, t, k -> β, ð, ɣ), more retroflex consonants, and centuries of Aragonese-Catalan/Spanish contact influence on the lexicon. Wired as a graphemes_base dialect of sc (Sardinian), mirroring the sc-x-campidanese extended-tag entry, but filed under its own ISO 639-3 code.
